Derya i Aziz, poznati umjetnički par iz Turske, žive naizgled skladnim obiteljskim životom sa svojom kćeri Ezgi. No nakon incidenta na premijeri njihove drame, njihov odnos se počinje razdvajati.

candidate.en: Kumpanija — Čara is one of the five villages on Korčula Island that preserves the Kumpanija sword dance, a chain sword dance of great antiquity performed in summer and listed as UNESCO intangible cultural heritage.
Harvest season — the grape harvest in Carsko Polje in September and early October is one of the most visually striking seasonal events on the island, with the whole field in activity.
